item.title: Kuresaki Gakuen's Story
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cinema Supply
  • 発売日: 1997-09-05
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 紅崎学園物語
  • 英語名: Kuresaki Gakuen’s Story

あらすじ

The protagonist’s parents are going on a month-long trip abroad to celebrate their wedding anniversary, leaving the protagonist at home with his sister-in-law Asuka, who is six months younger than him. A special month begins in which the protagonist lives alone with Asuka, and interacts with Aya, the protagonist’s childhood friend, and Maiko, a senior who he admires.
